extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.9 - BingeTV: after switching profile, Home opens on its menu bar's Home button. v0.17.8 - BingeTV: the profile picker shows the profiles like "Who's watching?", each with its options in its context menu (picture, rename, delete, add a profile); Exit BingeTV is there too. Settings that change the menu bar (hide Music or Live TV) apply straight away. v0.17.7 - BingeTV profiles: a new profile's setup (its own MDBList key) is no longer cut short as the profile loads, and Live TV copied into it is turned on. v0.17.6 - A title's context menu is just Play, Information, Show Playable Streams, Mark as watched and Add to (or Remove from) watchlist. On BingeTV, Music and Live TV have their own Home rows: Kodi's music library, Live TV channels, channel groups and recordings, or a folder of any add-on.
